The following metrics apply to the Date processor. Each metric is preﬁxed by the sub-pipeline
name and date. For example,
sub_pipeline_name.date.dateProcessingMatchSuccess.count.

Description

hSuccess.count
The number of records that match at least one of the
patterns speciﬁed in the match conﬁguration option.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
